about: VERIFY_HARDENING 18: the price list of escapes (every declaration that removes or weakens a check). points are subtracted from the strength score (19.1); review "review" always needs an accepted record in catalog/review/exemptions.jsonl (policy "escape:<key>[:<item>]", 10.7), "quota" is accepted without review up to quota_points per spec in total (beyond that each needs one), "none" is recorded only. Gate G9: at most max_points in all and at most max_exemptions accepted battery and must-pass exemptions. Read by house_sim/tasks/escapes.py price_list() (WP5) and lint L-ESCAPE (house_sim/tasks/lint.py, WP8).

deliver_non_target.what: envelope.deliver for a selector that is not an instruction target or recipient (6.6)

consume_non_target.what: envelope.consume for a selector that is not an instruction target (6.6)

agents_non_target.what: envelope.agents allowance for a person or pet that is not the instruction's target or recipient (6.6)

battery_exempt.what: accepted battery_exempt proposal (10.7; at most 2 exemptions in all)

lookahead_short.what: lookahead_s off or shorter than 6 h when the look-ahead is triggered (6.10)

no_state_label.what: no state-kind success label while the analysis success text names a physical state (8.3)

protect_waive.what: protect_map waive, the second and later ones (7.2)

held_at_end.what: envelope.held_at_end entry; free when the instruction asks the robot to keep holding it (6.4)

roles_context.what: instruction_roles: context for a placeholder after a destination preposition (13.7)

never_touch_change.what: envelope.change entry on a never-touch item (6.4)

create_unnamed.what: envelope.create scope for a hazard class the instruction does not name (6.6)

scene_exception.what: L-SCENE exception: no look-alike group where the entry kind expects one (spec key scene_exception, 20.2)

unrealisable.what: unrealisable exemption (battery debt, reviewed by the battery owner WP6, 10.7)

fungible.what: declared fungible role, each; automatic fungibility is free (10.3)

transit_ok.what: transit_ok carrier instance the instruction does not name, each (6.5)

narrow_to.what: narrow to scope on a non-target the instruction does not name, each (6.6)

process_unproposed.what: process label the draft did not propose, each (8.1)

absent_ok_uncovered.what: absent_ok label whose entity is not covered by consume / deliver for a target, each (8.6)

hold_open.what: hold_open_s above the default, or a restore-class envelope.change entry, each (6.9)

budget_reason.what: budget_reason: a budget looser than the formula; halves c_budget instead of points (17)

budget_only_defense.what: a battery policy whose only defense was the budget, each (10.4)

tier_reduced.what: horizon-tier reduced run plans (skipped:tier, 22.2): recorded, fixed per tier
